messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] High GPU queue growth in inference-prod cluster (region-us-west2). autoscale did not recover. priority=sev2 :rotating_light:

alice_oncall: picking this up. seeing spike on metrics dashboard. queue depth ~18k, 95p latency cratered, errors for some customers.

raj_ml_infra: hey, looks like many pods are Pending due to MIG fragmenting — free GPU slices exist but can't satisfy requested MIG shapes. nodes show partial free MIG capacity.

ken_runtime: confirming. scheduler logs show binpack rejects because pods request specific mig-counts (gpus=1mig:2/4) and placement can't co-locate. autoscaler hit scaleLimit=40 and is still queued.

alice_oncall: status: throttling new inference requests for non-paid tiers now. lia, can you confirm customer-facing impact?

lia_cx: notified 3 impacted enterprise customers via email, waiting on confirmed ETA. customers seeing timeouts and 503s on heavy inference routes.

sam_ops: I can attempt emergency rebalance to consolidate MIG slices. want to try drain+binpack across 3 nodes to free contiguous MIGs. will need a quick canary and to pause autoscaler to avoid oscillation.

raj_ml_infra: +1. proposed steps: 1) pause cluster-autoscaler, 2) label nodes for manual binpack, 3) run node-drain with --grace-period=60 for low-priority pods, 4) force schedule high-prio inference pods to target nodes.

ken_runtime: add fallback: switch heavy routes to smaller quantized model variant (model-q8) for 15 mins to reduce gpu hours. I'll push config change now.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by ken_runtime: switch = model-q8 as fallback on route /v1/generate heavy (deploy-id=deploy-8791).

alice_oncall: ken — once fallback is active, sam do rebalance. raj, please prepare MIG resize script. include safety checks to not drop active customer jobs.

ken_runtime: fallback active. traffic route shows 40% of heavy requests on model-q8. latency improved slightly.

sam_ops: starting rebalance plan. running dry-run command:```bash
# find candidate nodes
kubectl get nodes -l gpu=true -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.status.allocatable}
'```

sam_ops: draining node gpu-node-17 now (low-priority pods only). draining with:```bash
kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60 --pod-selector='priority!=high'```

raj_ml_infra: monitoring MIG occupancy. current mapping: node-15: 2x1mig free, node-17: 3x1mig free, node-19: fragmented 2x0.5mig. hoping to consolidate to node-17 to allow pod placement.

alice_oncall: I'm coordinating with infra to keep autoscaler paused. also opening a support ticket with cloud vendor in case we need temporary quota bump.

ken_runtime: noticing some pods failing create due to resourceReservation mismatch error: "requested_mig_shapes_unavailable" — that's the fragmentation.

raj_ml_infra: trying MIG reslice on node-19 to convert 4x0.5 -> 2x1. Need a short maintenance window ~2m per node. risk: preemptible workloads may be interrupted.

sam_ops: performing reslice on node-19 now.```bash
# run vendor tool
vendor-mig-tool reslice --node node-19 --target 2x1 --force --drain-behavior=evict-low```

deploy-bot: vendor-mig-tool job started (job-id=vm-33421). estimated 90s.

lia_cx: customers asking for ETA. telling them ~20-30m while we rebalance and monitor, but will update in 10m.

alice_oncall: if reslice succeeds, we will unpause autoscaler and allow scale to refill up to limit. if not, fallback to route-level rate limit and scale-up request to infra team.

raj_ml_infra: reslice completed on node-19. MIG shapes now show 2x1 contiguous. scheduling attempts succeeding for a subset of pending pods.

ken_runtime: I see new pods hitting nodes and startup logs show KV cache warm start. queue depth dropping to 6k. good.

sam_ops: continuing to drain and consolidate node-21 next. drainer script will skip high-priority pods.

alice_oncall: lia, update customers: mitigation in progress, queue decreasing, partial restoration. we've enabled fallback model for heavy routes. ETA now 10-15m.

lia_cx: updated customers. they appreciate the quick response. scheduling follow-up call with one customer worried about missed SLAs.

ken_runtime: small regression: model-q8 returns slightly different outputs for some prompts, enabled quality flags to route sensitive customers back to dedicated reserve if available.

raj_ml_infra: autoscaler unpaused and allowed to add up to scaleLimit=45 now that fragmentation reduced. scheduling backlog drained further to ~1200.

alice_oncall: monitoring for 15 more mins. will do on-call handoff to raj in 30m for post-mitigation cleanup. create incident ticket and postmortem stub.

sam_ops: I'm running a script to mark nodes for future pre-emptive compaction to avoid this:```yaml
# compaction cron
apiVersion: batch/v1beta1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: gpu-compactor
spec:
  schedule: "0 */4 * * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: compactor
            image: redwood/gpu-compactor:stable
            args: ["--evict-low-priority", "--merge-migs"]
```

alice_oncall: nice. add that to postmortem remediation section.

lia_cx: will follow up with impacted customers and attach timeline.

alice_oncall: closing pager for now, leaving thread open for notes. creating incident-2790001234 in tracker and assigning to raj for RCA and follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

raj_ml_infra: ack. I'll collect logs, scheduler traces, and autoscaler metrics, and propose changes: relaxed mig-request admission, binpack scoring change, and preemptive compaction job.

deploy-bot: ticket created: INC-2790001234 (assignee=raj_ml_infra).

alice_oncall: thanks team. postmortem draft due EOD tomorrow.
